label: RTX 5060 Ti
notes: Clean 5060 Ti measurements with only one model engine active. LM Studio: 10 models, per-test KV allocation, no CPU placement fallback, normally 300s practical test limit; final Bonsai 80K pair repeat allowed 600s after a borderline 300s cutoff. Strata: 3 models, fixed 96K context, MTP requested on, Flash Next host expert cache capped at 40 GiB after automatic startup exhausted RAM (5070 Ti used automatic host residency), one backend slot; two clients queue. Primary Strata measurements use Samsung SATA, matching the 5070 Ti storage setup. NVMe pairs and raw data are retained in storage_comparison. RAM firmware reports 2133 MT/s; BIOS unchanged. See session settings, limits and runtime observations.

collection.policy: Read-only allow-listed OS/driver probes without elevation; no unique device IDs, host names, network addresses or user paths.

memory.note: Channel topology includes source, method and capture time. Populated channels and active controller mode are distinct. Clocks are firmware/OS reports; transfer probes are stored separately.

channel_topology.note: Independent controller report identified Quad mode. Built-in firmware topology corroborates four populated channels. This later check does not establish historical inference settings; Wattever requires no CPU-Z installation.

native_probe.note: Populated channels inferred from explicit firmware channel/slot labels, not DIMM count. Active controller mode is unverified.

pcie.note: Snapshot may show an idle downshift. Reported maxima can reflect platform limits. Encoding ceiling excludes packet/system overhead and is not measured transfer bandwidth.

capabilities.note: No FLOPS/TOPS or device-memory bandwidth measurement was performed. Model quantization bit width is not hardware arithmetic precision; peak compute also depends on operation, clock and sparsity.

storage_to_ram.note: Sequential reads of a flushed temporary file on the selected volume (results volume by default). File creation is excluded. Device/controller caches may contribute; model files on other volumes need separate measurement.

ram_to_vram.note: Pinned RAM to device memory; host wall time includes completed copies and synchronization. Separate microbenchmark, not observed inference traffic or VRAM internal bandwidth.

ram_copy_single.note: Native RAM copy payload throughput. Each payload byte requires a source read and destination write; 2x this rate is logical read+write bandwidth, not measured DRAM bus traffic. Cache/write-allocation effects and worker count influence results.

ram_copy_parallel.note: Native RAM copy payload throughput. Each payload byte requires a source read and destination write; 2x this rate is logical read+write bandwidth, not measured DRAM bus traffic. Cache/write-allocation effects and worker count influence results.
